subject: 1093年大理国大理王府段氏宫室（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Precise geometric edit of this Dali palace sprite. Preserve all building identity and materials. Correct the right-hand perimeter: it is too steep; redraw the entire camera projection so BOTH visible ground edges have EQUAL 26.565degree angles to horizontal. Current screen-left edge is about27.5degrees, screen-right edge about30degrees. Right edge must become SHALLOWER by3.5degrees; left edge becomes shallower by1degree. Move the rightmost ground corner downward relative to front while reprojecting that side coherently. Target thin ground corners LEFT(100,560), FRONT(860,940), RIGHT(1452,644), BACK(692,264). Width/depth ratio760/592=1.284. Equally sloped2:1 dimetric orthographic, verticals stay vertical. All ground paving aligned, both front walls meet these slopes, no perspective or screen rotation. Main hall, side pavilions, gate, stone court, few camellias, gray tiled roofs, cream walls, muted dark timber,1093 Dali royalty. TRUE transparent RGBA, opaque building, generous margin. No people,text,signs,grid,watermark,modern objects or external terrain. Final geometry must match exactly, not generic isometric.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚底座、旅游古城风格、裁切、透视汇聚

references.role: 返修生成输入；建筑候选为编辑目标，projection_guide为程序绘制的精确占地QA几何指导（非入库美术）

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 已逐张view_image检查原图与成品QA叠图；无文字、水印、现代物件和人物，完整RGBA透明留边；光源左上。王府明显歪轴已修复，保留灰瓦、浅墙与山茶；右轴略陡严格检查仍有告警。仅裁切、等比LANCZOS缩放、透明扩边；历史细部与风格仍待作者审批。
